titles.romaji: Gekkou no Pierce: Yumemi to Gin no Bara no Kishidan
titles.native: 月光のピアス―ユメミと銀のバラ騎士団

description: Because of a mysterious earring, Yumemi a young japanese student, becomes involved in a mysterious story. She must go to Germany, where she learns that the spirit of an evil prince is haunting her earring...
